messages:
Aisha: Quick heads-up on Greenfield onboarding — p95 inference latency jumped to ~1.8s on 8k seqs this morning, cost per 10k tokens up ~18% vs baseline.
Devon: ugh. do we have hot endpoints? which model are they pinned to?
Aisha: They're on rdx-reasoner-v2 (base fp16), traffic spiky after activation. Most hits are long-context summarization.
Liam: :eyes: sounds like KV-cache churn. Two quick pilots: 1) quantized int8 canary on low-traffic path, 2) route long-context requests to dedicated pool or compact model.
Carla: renewal sync next week — want to show proactive ops. can we get an estimate of cost savings if we do int8 + routing?
Devon: rough calc: int8 ~30-40% token cost drop, latency down ~15-25% on GPU1; dedicated routing depends on batchability but could shave another 10-20%.
samir-bot: [alert] Greenfield: success_rate drop 2.4% since 08:00 UTC, avg tokens/request 2.1k, qps 6.3
Devon: propose canary plan:
```
route_policy:
  - match: /long-summarize
    action: route-dedicated-pool-a
    fallback: compact-reasoner-1
    canary_pct: 5
quantization:
  model: rdx-reasoner-v2
  profile: int8-llm-sparse
```
Liam: I'll scope dedicated pool capacity for 10% of peak, add autoscale buffer. I'll also add KV warmup to reduce cold-KV misses.
Aisha: Can CS own feedback capture? I'll run a 3-question pulse in the onboarding flow and collect examples of bad outputs for eval set.
Carla: Assign roles: Devon -> build canary image by Thu EOD, Liam -> infra + routing by Fri AM, Aisha -> customer comms + feedback hook, me -> renewal talking points.
Devon: I'll post the canary image tag here when ready and a quick perf script.
Aisha: Great, let's loop in the enablement call Friday 10:30 PT. :zap: Thanks team — will capture results and send a short win/loss note for renewal deck.
